parts.t: What is the City of Delta Official Community Plan (OCP)?
Delta's Official Community Plan sets the long-term land-use vision, housing density designations, Urban Containment Boundary, and infrastructure policies across
How does BC Bill 44 (SSMUH) affect single-family lots in Delta?

Under provincial Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing legislation and Delta's updated zoning bylaw, qualifying single-family lots inside the Urban Containment Boundary can accommodate secondary suites, garden suites, duplexes, or 3- to 4-unit infill housing, subject to site servicing, flood levels, and setback rules.
How do I look up the zoning and lot dimensions of a Delta property?
Use the City of Delta's online mapping tool (DeltaMap GIS) alongside our
Fraser Valley & Metro Vancouver Zoning Guide
to check the exact zoning code, lot frontage, utility mains, Flood Construction Level, and Development Permit Areas.
What rules apply to Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) parcels in Delta?
are governed by both the Agricultural Land Commission (ALC) and the City of Delta, which regulate principal residence floor area, additional residences, farm retail, and soil/fill permits.
What are Flood Construction Levels (FCL) in Ladner and Boundary Bay?

Low-lying areas of Ladner, Beach Grove, and Boundary Beach sit inside designated floodplain zones where new construction must meet minimum habitable floor elevations (FCL) and include a site-specific geotechnical report for preload and foundation design.
When is a Development Permit required in the City of Delta?

Delta requires a Development Permit before building or subdividing inside designated Development Permit Areas (such as Scott Road Corridor, Ladner Village, Tsawwassen Town Centre, environmentally sensitive streamside areas, and hazard/geotechnical slopes in English Bluff).
